metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-xe[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Remote dispatch and the Focus/Fleet agents experience[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A user can enroll remote machines (Tailnet by default, plain HTTPS [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]without Tailscale), launch agents on them with %dispatch:<machine>,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]browse every enrolled machine's agents in a new Fleet sub-view of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the Agents tab, follow remote agents into the Focus sub-view, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]manage followed remote agents (view, kill, retry, fork, answer [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]questions, approve gates) with the same action vocabulary as local [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agents - all with zero added cost when no machines are configured [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and no event-loop stalls when a machine hangs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]15[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]remote_dispatch_fleet.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/remote_dispatch_fleet.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-xe[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-xe/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bounded index-backed local listing reads[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]local-reads[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]local-reads: remove the redundant child-summary scan from the CLI agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]listing, route the CLI and mobile-bridge listings through one bounded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]index-backed summary query with owner-side liveness, and add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scan/candidate/decode instrumentation so later remote summary endpoints [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]have a fast, measurable local substrate.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Portable identity, resolved records, and operation contracts [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]identity-contracts[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]identity-contracts: define per-user installation identity, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]origin/agent/family/run locators, versioned resolved summary and detail [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record types, capability sets, the single running-count definition, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store-generation-plus-sequence cursor, and serializable connection-plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and operation-key types in the transport-free sase_core domain crate, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exposed through the existing PyO3 binding.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Split owner resolution from pure presentation in ACE loaders[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]viewer-purity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after local-reads, identity-contracts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]viewer-purity: extract the local side effects concentrated in the ACE [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]running-agent loaders (stale-claim release, running-marker unlink, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact-index mutation, PID liveness) into an owner-resolution step so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rendering consumes resolved records and opaque handles only, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]effect-failing tests proving remote-origin records can never trigger [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]local process or path effects.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Authenticated enrollment and hardened gateway access[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]gateway-auth[dim] · [dim][/dim]after identity-contracts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gateway-auth: add a fleet API with target-authorized bootstrap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]enrollment, short-lived single-use enrollment secrets, scoped revocable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bearer credentials, a hello/capabilities/version-negotiation handshake, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]installation-identity pinning with quarantine on mismatch, rate limits, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and fixes for the hot-path auth costs, replacing reliance on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]self-authorizing loopback pairing flow for anything remotely reachable.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bounded remote read protocol with recoverable events[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]gateway-reads[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gateway-auth[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gateway-reads: serve maintained resolved summaries, bounded catalog [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pages, batch followed-ID lookups, lazy detail, and content handles over [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]versioned HTTP/JSON by calling the core scan/index in-process, and make [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the SSE stream actually deliver post-connect invalidations through a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]broadcast channel with a generation-plus-sequence cursor and an explicit[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resync path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable mutation journal and launch admission recovery[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]op-journal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gateway-auth[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]op-journal: add operation keys with payload fingerprints, receipts and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tombstones through a documented retry window, atomic run reservation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before spawn, crash recovery that finds the admitted run instead of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relaunching, and exact-instance fencing so a reused name or PID is never[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]targeted.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Dispatch provider plugin hooks, built-in providers, and config[bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]schema[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]dispatch-plugins[dim] · [dim][/dim]after identity-contracts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatch-plugins: add the sase_dispatch entry-point group with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatch_provider_spec, dispatch_discover, and dispatch_connection_plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hooks following the metadata-only finalizers loading model, built-in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tailnet and https providers, the dispatch: config section with schema [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and layer-aware parsing, mode-restricted credential storage, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remote_dispatch beta feature flag.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase machine CLI group and sase init enrollment[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]machine-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gateway-auth, dispatch-plugins[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]machine-cli: add the sase machine command group (add, discover, list, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remove, rename, repair, status) wired through the parser registry with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the default-list convention, an init-registry spec that offers [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remote-machine enrollment during sase init, and doctor checks for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]enrolled machine records.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable follow subscriptions with family continuity[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]follow-store[dim] · [dim][/dim]after identity-contracts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-store: persist viewer-local follow records keyed by origin and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]logical agent/family identity, promote singleton follows to the family [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity when a family forms, make explicit unfollow tombstones win over[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]automatic re-creation, and implement the shared Focus/Fleet [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]running-count calculations over authoritative summaries with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unknown-host propagation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Local federation worker and Python remote facade[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]federation-worker[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gateway-reads, dispatch-plugins[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]federation-worker: build the on-demand per-user Rust worker that owns [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remote connections, cached projections, per-host deadlines and backoff, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and subscription-driven reconciliation behind a permission-restricted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]local IPC endpoint, plus the Python facade, binary packaging, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]process supervision that ACE and the CLI call.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Focus and Fleet sub-views of the Agents tab[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]fleet-ui[dim] · [dim][/dim]after viewer-purity, follow-store, federation-worker[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fleet-ui: add an agents-header strip with Focus and Fleet modes over the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing agent list widgets, running-count chips with partial and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]freshness states, machine section headers, follow stars and accent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rails, bounded intent previews, per-mode selection/fold/scroll state, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new named configurable keybindings, and demand-tiered hydration that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]does no remote work when no machine is enrolled.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  12 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The %dispatch directive and reliable remote launch[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]dispatch-launch[dim] · [dim][/dim]after op-journal, machine-cli, federation-worker[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatch-launch: add %dispatch:<machine> to the dual-sourced directive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vocabulary, intercept routing in the shared launch trunk before any [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]target-side allocation, persist source intent with an operation key, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]send a portable launch request validated and admitted on the target, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bind the receipt, auto-follow the resulting family, and reconcile lost [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]replies without ever falling back to another machine.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  13 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Remote lifecycle management parity[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]remote-actions[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fleet-ui, dispatch-launch[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]remote-actions: execute kill/stop, retry, and fork-on-target for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]followed remote agents through the mutation journal with exact instance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity, stream bounded output/diff/chat content through opaque [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handles, and partition bulk actions per origin with honest per-target [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]results.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  14 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Remote questions, gates, and notification deduplication[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]attention-parity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after remote-actions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]attention-parity: surface remote question and gate attention in Focus [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]promptly, answer questions and approve gates through consume-once [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mutation semantics with an already-answered result for a losing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]controller, and deduplicate notifications by origin plus request [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity across reconnects.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  15 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fleet-wide acceptance, flag removal, and polish[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after attention-parity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance: run the performance and failure acceptance matrix [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](local-first paint, j/k p95 under hung hosts, laziness tiers, fault [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery), finish keyboard-only/narrow/no-color UX review with updated [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]PNG snapshots, remove the remote_dispatch beta flag by making the On [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]branch unconditional, and record proposed follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
